description: The parties of the UBL example world: their place on the map, what they do and their identity. referenced: parties that are only referred to in a document (identifier and name), with no place on the map and no documents of their own.

parties.name: Raw Material Supplier
parties.what: Mines the ore at the start of the chain and sells it to the manufacturer.
parties.how: A mine sells a few products in large volumes to a small number of customers. With UBL, its orders, despatch advices and invoices carry the same quantities, lot numbers and weights from the first document to the last, so the buyer can match them without retyping weighbridge tickets.

site.description: The mine and its rail siding
site.conditions: Unpaved access road; heavy vehicles only.

parties.name: Manufacturer
parties.what: Makes park benches and street furniture: frames of ductile iron made from the mine's ore and about 35 % steel and iron scrap and cast in its own foundry, slats from the sawmill in Bayvarra, packed in recycled packaging from Bayvarra. Sells to the distributor abroad and tenders in public procurement.
parties.how: The manufacturer sits in the middle of the chain: it buys, produces, sells, exports and tenders. UBL gives it one vocabulary for all of that, from the order it places with the mine to the certificate of origin and the tender it submits to a public buyer, so the same item, party and price data are reused instead of re-entered for every partner.

account_abroad.why: A lume account at Bank of Lumeport, which also gave Valdara's tender guarantee: the public works department pays the framework contract in its own currency into a domestic account, and Valdara converts later if it wants, its currency risk covered by its forward contract (O226, O50).

parties.name: Seller's Warehouse (3PL)
parties.what: Picks, packs and hands the goods to the carrier for the manufacturer; knows nothing about prices.
parties.how: A third-party warehouse acts on instructions from its client but never sees the commercial terms. UBL separates the two: the warehouse sends despatch advices and inventory reports with exactly the logistic details (packages, weights, serial numbers) while prices stay in the documents between seller and buyer.

parties.name: Waste Processor
parties.what: Recovers polyethylene from the production waste of several factories, Valdara's among them: it collects the baled film, weighs each load on its weighbridge, reports it to the environment agency and invoices the net tonnes; it sells the granulate it makes, certified for its recycled content (decisions D41, D42).
parties.how: Waste movements must be announced and tracked before the waste leaves the site. UBL's waste notification and waste movement documents describe the waste, its producer and the facility that recovers or disposes of it, and the same parties then appear on the invoice for the removal service.

parties.name: Rail Carrier
parties.what: Runs the ore trains from the mine to the factory and the container trains from the Ferrano hub to Lumeway's siding in Marrowdale, on train paths of the rail infrastructure manager; its tractor brings the containers to the hub (decisions D37, D45).
parties.how: A rail carrier plans capacity on a fixed timetable. UBL transport documents let its customers request and confirm transport plans and receive status updates per train and wagon, with the same consignment references the forwarder and the receiving terminal use.

parties.name: Road Carrier
parties.what: Trucks the goods across the land border, both ways: benches to Bayvarra, slats and film back to Urvania; registered with Urvania's environment agency as a waste carrier, it also takes Valdara's baled waste film to Rinova across Ferrano.
parties.how: Road carriers handle many short jobs with frequent changes. With UBL they receive transport instructions, report status at each stop and invoice the freight in one structured format, so every customer, large or small, can process them automatically.

authorization.purpose: Transport of non-hazardous waste by road
authorization.note: Shown where Trasvia carries waste (D42); its road haulage licence XU-HAUL-2020-0877 (haulage-licence register, valid to 2030-06-30) covers its other carriage and is not shown in a document.

parties.name: Inland Waterway Carrier
parties.what: Moves bulk on the river from Urvania down to the coast of Bayvarra.
parties.how: Inland waterway transport moves large volumes slowly. UBL transport execution plans and waybills carry the barge, the loading and discharge quays and the cargo per hold, so shippers and terminals can plan around long transit times.

parties.name: Rail Hub / Intermodal Terminal
parties.what: The intermodal terminal of Ferrano, on the container line that runs on past the border to Marrowdale: it takes the containers in by road, stacks them and lifts them onto the container trains, and reports to the rail carrier what it has loaded; the tracks and the train paths are the rail infrastructure manager's (decision D37).
parties.how: An intermodal terminal is where rail and road meet. UBL status messages and transport reports let it tell carriers and forwarders when a container arrived, was transferred or left, using the same equipment and consignment identifiers on both sides of the transfer.

parties.name: Seller's Bank
parties.what: Holds the manufacturer's account and receives the payments from abroad.
parties.how: The seller's bank receives payments from many countries. Because UBL invoices carry the payee account and a payment reference, and remittance advices repeat that reference, incoming payments can be matched to the right invoices automatically.

parties.name: Chamber of Commerce (XU)
parties.what: Certifies the origin of the exported goods and issues ATA carnets.
parties.how: A chamber of commerce certifies that goods come from where the exporter says. UBL certificate-of-origin and goods-item-passport documents carry the application, the endorsements and the goods in a form customs on the other side can read and verify.

parties.name: Customs (XU)
parties.what: Export customs at the land border crossing.
parties.how: Export customs needs to know what leaves the country, for whom and how. UBL customs declarations reuse the parties, goods and transport details already present in the commercial and transport documents, so the declarant does not have to collect them again.

parties.name: Identifier Issuing Agency
parties.what: Issues item and property identifiers used across the world (a fictional numbering organisation).
parties.how: Everyone in the world refers to the same products and properties. An identifier issuing agency gives those items and properties stable identifiers, which UBL documents carry in their identification elements, so a catalogue line, an order line and an invoice line point to exactly the same thing.

parties.name: Customs (XB)
parties.what: Import customs at the land border crossing and at the seaport.
parties.how: Import customs checks goods arriving over the land border and through the seaport. UBL import and transit declarations carry the same consignment and goods data as the export declaration on the other side, which makes it possible to compare them.

identity.name: Customs and Border Service of Bayvarra

parties.name: Distributor
parties.what: Buys finished goods from #5, stocks them in its distribution centre, publishes the catalogue and sells to #26 and overseas to #1.
parties.how: The distributor publishes the catalogue its customers order from, buys from manufacturers and sells at home and overseas. UBL links all of it: catalogue items appear unchanged in orders, orders are referenced by despatch advices and invoices, and receipt advices confirm what actually arrived.

siding.name: Rail siding of the distribution centre, Marrowdale

goodsin.name: Distribution centre, goods-in
goodsin.description: Goods-in, dock 4 of the distribution centre, entered by gate 3 of Marrowdale Business Park

parties.name: Retailer
parties.what: Buys from the distributor, sells to consumers; shares forecasts and promotions.
parties.how: A retailer buys from the distributor and sells to consumers. Besides orders and invoices, UBL lets it share forecasts, promotions and sales data with its supplier, and issue a structured purchase receipt to the consumer.

garden.name: Home and garden department of the Lumeport store

card_mask.note: The store's tills print only the last four digits of a card number.

parties.name: Consumer
parties.what: A private person buying in the shop; receives a purchase receipt.
parties.how: A consumer rarely deals with UBL directly, but a structured purchase receipt means the receipt can be stored, searched or used for a warranty claim without a paper slip.

parties.name: Contracting Authority
parties.what: A public body that buys under procurement law: publishes notices, receives and evaluates tenders.
parties.how: A contracting authority has to buy in a transparent and comparable way. UBL tendering documents take it from the prior information notice to the contract award, so tenders arrive in a structured form that can be checked and evaluated consistently.

identity.name: Lumeport Public Works Department
identity.tax_exemption: Buys free of the state sales tax

cost_centre.name: Parks and green spaces: parks renewal programme 2026

identity.address_desks_note: The address's department, attention and in-house mail lines are the procurement office's: they go with the roles it answers for, and are left out where another office of the department is addressed.

parties.name: Consortium Partner
parties.what: An engineering firm founded in 1994 in Saltmere, the east-coast village it is named after, when Bayvarra's mobile networks were built; it later moved to Marrowdale, on the road and rail to Urvania. It designs telecom mast sites and obtains their permits (a registered architect, Edda Corwin, is on its staff), and installs back-up power and safety equipment at masts across Bayvarra, dangerous goods included, with crews and anchoring gear for ground foundations. It installs and anchors the park benches as Valdara's subcontractor in the public tender, and in the design contest it teams with Brackenmere Furniture for the structure and the anchoring (D28 point 3, D29 point 2, O97, O222).
parties.how: A subcontractor or a member of a group of tenderers is named with its own role. UBL tenders and qualification documents name each member and its qualifications separately, so the authority can see who contributes what and check each one in the register.

parties.name: Review Body
parties.what: Independent body that handles appeals and mediation in public procurement.
parties.how: A review body handles appeals against procurement decisions. The tendering documents name it, with the deadlines for an appeal, so every tenderer knows where and when to go.

parties.name: Government Information Service
parties.what: Publishes procurement notices and keeps the business registry.
parties.how: A government information service publishes procurement notices and keeps the business registry. UBL notices reach it in one structured format, and business information documents let it share registry data that tenderers can reuse as evidence.

parties.name: Digital Agreement Governor
parties.what: Governs the multilateral digital agreement under which the parties exchange UBL documents.
parties.how: A digital agreement sets out which documents the participants exchange and under which rules. UBL's digital agreement and digital capability documents describe that framework, and its governor keeps it up to date for all participants.

parties.name: Factor
parties.what: Buys the distributor's receivables and becomes the payee on its invoices.
parties.how: A factor buys the distributor's invoices and collects the payment. UBL invoices can name the factor as payee, with its account, so the buyer pays the right party without a separate letter.

parties.name: Bank / Guarantor
parties.what: Bayvarra's bank: holds the accounts of the distributor, its customers and the public buyer, and issues guarantees, such as the bid bond for a tender.
parties.how: A guarantor stands surety, for example for a bid bond in a tender. UBL's guarantee certificate names the guarantee, the tenderer and the contracting authority, so the authority can check it is valid.

parties.name: Insurer
parties.what: Insures the cargo on its way overseas.
parties.how: An insurer covers the cargo while it travels. UBL transport documents can carry the insurance policy with the insurer, the policy holder and the insured value, so every party in the transport chain knows the goods are covered.

parties.name: Freight Forwarder
parties.what: Books the transport, consolidates shipments and prepares the export documents; arranges cargo insurance; runs its own trucks within Bayvarra, to the port, the airport and the store.
parties.how: A freight forwarder organises transport for others. It uses UBL forwarding instructions, packing lists and manifests to combine shipments, book carriers and arrange insurance, keeping one consignment reference across all of them.

parties.name: Seaport (XB)
parties.what: Port of loading: berths, container yard and vessel traffic.
parties.how: The seaport loads the ship. UBL transport reports and status messages tell the port which containers are coming, and tell carriers and authorities what was loaded, on which vessel and when.

parties.name: Ocean Carrier
parties.what: Sails the container ship to the island and issues the negotiable bill of lading.
parties.how: The ocean carrier issues the bill of lading, the document that represents the goods at sea. With UBL that document, the vessel reports and the status updates share the same consignment and container references as the forwarder's booking.

fleet.name: Tidewell Reef
fleet.description: The line's second feeder, bought second-hand in December 2025 and moved to Bayvarra's flag on 15 January 2026. Until the flag state verifies its security system, it sails with an interim International Ship Security Certificate (ISPS Code A/19.4).

parties.name: Airport (XB)
parties.what: Air cargo terminal for urgent shipments overseas.
parties.how: The airport handles urgent cargo. UBL status messages let it report acceptance, loading and departure, with the air waybill reference the carrier and forwarder use.

parties.name: Seaport (XL)
parties.what: Port of discharge on the island.
parties.how: The island's seaport discharges the ship. It receives the same UBL transport report the loading port sent, so it can plan berths and inform customs before the vessel arrives.

parties.name: Airport (XL)
parties.what: The island's airport, where the air cargo arrives.
parties.how: The island's airport receives the air cargo and reports its arrival to the carrier and the consignee in UBL status messages.

identity.name: Selanu Airport Cargo
identity.city_why: The locality the airport lies in: the airfield is on the plain north of Selanu, within Lintwell, and bears the name of the capital it serves, as airports often do that lie in a neighbouring place (O152).

parties.name: Air Carrier
parties.what: The island's airline; flies urgent cargo, dangerous goods for cargo aircraft only included, with its ATR 72-600F freighter between Lumeport and Selanu.
parties.how: The air carrier flies urgent shipments. A UBL air waybill names the flight, its airports and times, the unit load devices and their positions on board, so the shipper, the terminals and the consignee read the carriage from one document.

fleet.name: ATR 72-600F freighter of Kelaro Air Cargo
fleet.description: An ATR 72-600F, the new-built freighter of the ATR 72-600 series (IATA aircraft type code ATF, ICAO type designator AT72): seven LD3 positions on the main deck (one of them for the active temperature-controlled RKN container), about 9,200 kg payload and 75 m³, a large cargo door of 2.94 × 1.80 m. A freighter, so it can carry the lithium batteries that are for cargo aircraft only.

capacity.source: ATR 72-600F fact sheet (atr-aircraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ATR_Fiche72-600F-3.pdf): 7 LD3 or 5 pallets 88 × 108 in or 9 pallets 88 × 62 in, plus aft bulk cargo in all configurations; large cargo door 2.94 × 1.8 m; max gross volume 75.0 m³; max structural payload 9,200 kg. The seven LD3 positions are numbered from the front.

AKE.name: LD3 container (AKE)
AKE.source: typical values of an aluminium AKE: tare about 82 kg, maximum gross 1,588 kg (3,500 lb), internal volume about 4.3 m³ (manufacturers' and airlines' data sheets; they vary by make)

RKN.name: active temperature-controlled LD3 container (RKN)
RKN.source: Envirotainer RKN e1 technical specification: tare 635 kg, maximum gross 1,588 kg, maximum net 953 kg, internal volume 2.3 m³

parties.name: Customs (XL)
parties.what: Import customs on the island.
parties.how: Import customs on the island receives a declaration that reuses the data of the export side and the transport documents, which speeds up clearance at the port.

parties.name: Customs Declarant / Broker
parties.what: Licensed agent that files the import declaration for the buyer; also acts as tax representative.
parties.how: A customs declarant files declarations for importers and can act as their tax representative. UBL gives it the commercial, transport and customs data in one vocabulary, so it can assemble the declaration from documents it already receives.

parties.name: Buyer's Warehouse (3PL)
parties.what: Receives the goods for the buyer and confirms what arrived; collects containers and cargo at the island's port and airport with its own truck.
parties.how: The buyer's warehouse receives the goods. Its UBL receipt advice confirms what arrived, per line and per package, which lets the buyer approve the invoice for exactly what was delivered.

parties.name: Commercial Buyer
parties.what: Needs the goods: orders from the distributor overseas and pays the invoice. Sells garden and park furniture to island customers from its shop in Selanu.
parties.how: The commercial buyer orders overseas and pays across borders. UBL lets it order from the distributor's catalogue, follow the goods through despatch and transport, match the invoice to the order and the receipt, and send a remittance advice with its payment.

card_mask.note: Velumi Trading's shop till prints the first six and the last four digits of a card number.

parties.name: Buyer's Bank
parties.what: Holds the buyer's account and sends the payment abroad.
parties.how: The buyer's bank sends the payment abroad. The payment reference and payee account come straight from the UBL invoice, so the payment arrives with the information the seller's bank needs to match it.

parties.name: Chamber of Commerce (XL)
parties.what: Guarantees ATA carnets on the import side.
parties.how: The chamber of commerce on the island guarantees goods-item passports for goods that enter temporarily, so customs can accept them without duties.

parties.name: Maritime Administration
parties.what: The island's flag state administration; issues ship security certificates.
parties.how: The island's maritime administration issues ship security certificates. UBL transport reports to the port carry the certificate and its issuer, so the port can check them before the ship arrives.

parties.name: Department of Agriculture (XL)
parties.what: The island's Department of Agriculture: its Plant Protection Service is Lisavu's plant protection organisation under the IPPC and issues the phytosanitary certificates of plants and plant products leaving the island; it also keeps the farm register.
parties.how: A plant protection organisation inspects a consignment before export and certifies it free of the pests the importing country names. UBL's goods certificate carries the inspection, its findings and the issuing authority, so the importing country's inspectors and customs can check it before the goods arrive.

parties.name: Energy Retailer
parties.what: Sells electricity and gas to Urvania's homes and businesses: buys electricity from the power station and gas from the gas producer, pays the grid operator for the networks, and bills the customers.
parties.how: In an unbundled market the retailer bills, but the grid operator owns and reads the meters. UBL keeps the two apart: the grid operator's Utility Statement carries the readings to the retailer, and the retailer's Invoice and Utility Statement carry them on to the customer.

parties.name: Water Utility
parties.what: Supplies drinking water in Coastal State, to shops and households.
parties.how: Water is billed on metered consumption. With UBL the Utility Statement carries the meter readings and the Invoice the amount; the tax exemption for water is stated explicitly, and a Reminder follows the same structure when a household pays late.

parties.name: Telecom Utility
parties.what: The island's telephone and data provider.
parties.how: Telecom bills list calls, data and subscriptions per line. The UBL Utility Statement has a telecommunications structure of its own, so a business customer can allocate the costs of each line without retyping a paper bill.

parties.name: Sawmill
parties.what: Fells timber in the forests of Upland State and saws it into planks, slats and beams at its mill on the north bank of the river; sells slats for the benches across the border and timber to the furniture maker.
parties.how: Wood is sold by dimensions and volume, in lots. UBL carries the measurements and the lot of every item in quotations, orders and despatch advices, so a buyer that orders slats to size gets exactly what it ordered and can trace each lot.

parties.name: Furniture Maker
parties.what: Makes wooden furniture from the sawmill's timber; supplies the department store and furnishes public offices, installation included.
parties.how: A supplier to a retailer shares more than orders: sales per store, stock policies and agreed exception thresholds. UBL's retail collaboration documents carry them, and a Work Report documents installation work for the customer to approve.

parties.name: Textile Mill
parties.what: Spins and weaves the island's cotton into fabric and makes clothing for the department store.
parties.how: Its raw material comes from overseas on a schedule. UBL forecasts and their revisions tell the ginnery what to expect, and the bill of lading, customs documents and invoice of every shipment arrive in one structure.

parties.name: Packaging Maker
parties.what: Makes packaging from recycled plastic granulate that arrives by barge from Urvania; packs the benches and the clothing.
parties.how: Recycled raw material comes in bulk lots by river; packaging goes out in many small orders. UBL handles both with the same order, despatch and invoice structure, across the border and at home.

parties.name: Cotton Farm
parties.what: Grows cotton on the island and delivers the seed cotton to the ginnery after the harvest.
parties.how: A farm does not write invoices: the ginnery weighs and grades the cotton and bills itself on the farm's behalf. UBL's self-billed invoice and credit note are made for exactly this, and the farm receives a structured statement of what it was paid for.

address.Description: Farm track off Plantation Road at kilometre 4, past the cotton fields.

parties.name: Cotton Ginnery
parties.what: Gins the farms' seed cotton into bales and exports them to the textile mill on the mainland: the island's export.
parties.how: The ginnery buys from many farms and sells overseas. UBL covers both sides: self-billing towards the farms, and towards the mill an export with weight statement, goods certificate, customs declaration and invoice.

parties.name: Gas Producer
parties.what: Produces natural gas from an offshore field off Bayvarra's north coast; treats it at its plant on the shore and sends it by pipeline to the power station and the grid of Urvania.
parties.how: Gas is sold by energy, measured at the border, and crosses it by pipeline every day. UBL carries the monthly sale as an Invoice in energy units, the export and import by fixed installation (transport mode 7) in the customs declarations, and a Reminder when the buyer pays late.

site.description: Gas treatment plant on the north coast; the platform of the offshore field lies about {km} kilometres out.

parties.name: Power Station
parties.what: A gas-fired power station near Serravona: burns gas from Bayvarra's offshore field and sells the electricity to the retail company through the grid.
parties.how: A producer sells energy in bulk, by the month, to a few buyers. UBL's Invoice carries the quantities in megawatt hours and the price per unit, and the Utility Statement of the grid operator shows what was fed in.

parties.name: Grid Operator
parties.what: Runs the electricity and gas networks of the Ferrano region: connects the power station and the gas pipeline, owns the meters, reads them and charges the retail company for the use of the networks.
parties.how: The grid operator measures what every customer takes, whoever sells to them. UBL's Utility Statement carries its readings to the retail company, with the corrections a gas meter needs, and its Invoice charges the network per connection.

parties.name: Environment Agency (XU)
parties.what: Urvania's environment agency, the competent authority of its waste law: it issues the permits of waste treatment plants, registers waste carriers, and receives the producers' notifications of their waste streams, which it acknowledges with a waste-stream number, and the facilities' reports of each load received (decision D42).
parties.how: A waste authority must know which waste moves, from whom and to which facility. UBL's waste notification tells it the waste stream before the movements start, and the waste movement reports each load as it is received, so the authority can follow the waste from the producer to its recovery without collecting the figures again.

parties.name: Rail Infrastructure Manager (XU)
parties.what: Urvania's rail infrastructure manager, a public body: it owns and maintains the country's tracks, allocates the train paths and runs the traffic control that dispatches every train on them, from the ore line to the border station. Urvania separated its rail infrastructure from the train operators, as it separated its electricity grid from supply, so Ferrano Rail Cargo runs its trains on paths it is given here (decision D37).
parties.how: A transport service provider asks the manager of the network where its train is. UBL's Transport Progress Status Request goes from the carrier to the transportation network manager, and the Transport Progress Status answers with the train's position and its timetable at each point the manager controls, so the carrier can tell its customers when the goods will arrive.

parties.name: Design Studio
parties.what: A small industrial design studio in Lumeport, founded in 2019 by two designers. It asked to take part in the design contest for the harbour promenade bench and was excluded at the selection: the certificate of the social security fund showed contributions due and unpaid, above the minor amounts the procurement act tolerates (O102).
parties.how: A candidate that is excluded is told why. UBL's Tenderer Qualification Response carries the decision on each candidate, with the reason for an exclusion, so the candidate knows where it stands and can appeal.

parties.name: Pharmaceutical Wholesaler
parties.what: A pharmaceutical wholesaler founded in 1991 beside Lumeport airport, so that medicines that come in by air and go on by air never wait far from the runway. It buys medicines, vaccines and radiopharmaceuticals from makers abroad, keeps them in its cold rooms at 2 to 8 °C and in a freezer room, and supplies pharmacies and hospitals in the three countries of the Accord. It holds the wholesale distribution authorisation of Bayvarra's medicines regulator, which the Accord's mutual recognition makes valid in Urvania and Lisavu, and a licence to hold and transport radioactive material. Its warehouse works every day and through the night, because radiopharmaceuticals arrive and leave by the night and early flights; its own van, with a driver trained for class 7, takes radioactive packages to the airport (D47, O202).
parties.how: A wholesaler sells many lines to many customers and must show, for medicines, the lot and its expiry date on every delivery. UBL's despatch advice carries the lot of each line and its expiry, and the transport documents the temperatures the goods need, so the hospital can check the cold chain and the lots when it receives them.

cold-room.name: Cold rooms of the Airport Road warehouse, 2 to 8 °C

fleet.name: Van for radioactive packages
fleet.description: A closed van with a locked, lined cargo compartment, placarded for class 7 when it carries a package with a Yellow label, driven by a driver trained for radioactive material.

parties.name: Hospital (XL)
parties.what: The island's general hospital in Selanu, a public body of Lisavu's health service: wards, an operating theatre, the island's vaccination service and a small nuclear medicine unit, which makes its technetium-99m every morning from a generator replaced once a week. Its pharmacy orders medicines, vaccines and the generator from a wholesaler in Lumeport; they come by air, and the pharmacy's van fetches them from the airport (D47).
parties.how: A hospital pharmacy buys by order and checks every delivery against the despatch advice: the lots, their expiry dates and the temperatures on the way. UBL lets it receive those facts with the goods and keep them with its stock.

fleet.name: Pharmacy van with a cooled compartment
fleet.description: The hospital pharmacy's van: a compartment kept at 2 to 8 °C, a freezer box and a locked, lined box for radioactive packages; its drivers are trained for class 7.

referenced.name: Maritime Administration
referenced.what: Bayvarra's flag state administration: keeps the register of Bayvarran ships and issues their international ship security certificates under the ISPS Code. Referenced only, as the issuer of the certificate of Tidewell Ocean Lines' ship.

referenced.name: Port Health Office
referenced.what: Bayvarra's port health authority at Lumeport, an office of the federal health administration, as the Maritime Administration is federal: under the International Health Regulations (2005) it inspects ships in the port and issues their ship sanitation control and exemption certificates (Annex 3) and the medicine chest certificates of Bayvarran ships (D30 point 8, O103). Referenced only, as the issuer of the certificates of Tidewell Ocean Lines' ships.

identity.name: Port Health Office of Bayvarra, Lumeport

referenced.name: Certification Body (XU)
referenced.what: An accredited certification body in Ferrano (a private company): it audits recycling plants for the traceability and the recycled content of what they make, under a recycled-content scheme that follows EN 15343:2007, as industry schemes such as RecyClass do, and issues their recycled-content certificates; it audits Rinova Recovery's plant every year (decision D41, O132). Referenced only, as the issuer of Rinova's certificate.

turnover_per_person.note: Rules of thumb for a company's yearly turnover per person, in lume, by the kind of business it is in (identity.legal.business): estimates of typical ranges, meant to catch the implausible (worklist decision D14, open point O30). Turnovers in ferra and coral count at the reference rates (world/countries.json exchange_rates). Only companies in a commercial register are checked: public bodies have no company figures, and a farm is entered in Lisavu's farm register, not the companies register (D46). tools/world_parties.py checks every company against its band. Shipping lines and oil and gas producers have bands of their own, because their ships and platforms make them earn far more per person than other transport or industry (owner, 2026-11-19).

oil_gas.name: Oil and gas production (capital-heavy: platforms, pipelines)

abroad.name: Isotope Maker (NL)
abroad.what: A fictional maker of radiopharmaceuticals in the Netherlands, outside the world: it fills molybdenum-99 from the research reactors of Europe into technetium-99m generators and sends them, pre-calibrated to a reference time six days after delivery, to hospitals and wholesalers around the world by scheduled air cargo from Amsterdam. Quillmoor Pharma Distribution buys one generator a week for Selanu General Hospital under a standing order (D47, O202 choice 3, O229). Not a party of the world: it has no place on the map; its name was checked against real companies.
abroad.how: A maker abroad sells in its own currency, the euro, and its invoice says how the goods left its country; the buyer converts the amount into lume for its books.

identity.name: Haarvliet Isotopes
identity.ids_note: It carries no identifier of a real register: a Dutch Chamber of Commerce number or VAT number in the real format could be someone's (O229); the documents identify it by its name and address, as a supplier outside the world.

abroad.name: Vaccine Maker (IN)
abroad.what: A fictional maker of vaccines and insulin in Hyderabad, India, outside the world: it makes seasonal influenza vaccines for both hemispheres, a live varicella vaccine and human insulin, and exports them by scheduled air cargo from Hyderabad. Quillmoor Pharma Distribution buys its vaccines and insulin for the southern winter from it (D47, O229). Not a party of the world: it has no place on the map; its name was checked against real companies.
abroad.how: A maker abroad sells in its own currency, the Indian rupee, and its invoice says how the goods left its country; the buyer converts the amount into lume for its books.

identity.name: Nilavar Biologics
identity.ids_note: It carries no identifier of a real register: an Indian company number, GSTIN or importer-exporter code in the real format could be someone's (O229); the documents identify it by its name and address, as a supplier outside the world.
